judgment_calls_for_kilian.question: Which outside path should COHR's optics market take in CY2028-29?
judgment_calls_for_kilian.context: mkt is the LightCounting AI-cluster Ethernet optics series (CY27 63.9B, CY28 83.4B, CY29 106.05B) that D&C capture is measured against; with capture held, D&C excluding the ~$20B PhotonLink LTA moves one-for-one with it (since 2026-11-17 the LTA is its own driver, lta_rev x 0.50, a contract value that does not scale with the market, so these sizes are smaller than before the split). SemiAnalysis' 11-13 Accelerator & HBM Model update (paid primary not reachable; Deep News relay via Tiger Brokers) cut accelerator capex 2027 -19%, 2028 -28%, 2029 -41% on slower lab ARR, financing and 5.8 GW of delays. The set keeps mkt and takes part of the risk through slower D&C growth after the Dec-2027 capacity step (+5%/+4% a quarter vs the market's ~+6.5%) and a 50% LTA haircut. It is a call because optics share of capex is rising and COHR says CY2027 is booked out, while the cut is the newest outside forecast and the horizon NTM year is CY2028. Also sized: the project's standing capex-file low and high cases for 2028 and LightCounting's narrower ~20%-a-year AI-cluster series, which the gate found cited but unsized. Re-sized 2026-11-17 on the set with the shared dc_mor moratorium haircut booked (309.66 after the gate fix re-derived the multiples on that set; 309.64 after the 2026-11-17 rebuild of the interest rate, 5.88%); Kilian's 2026-11-17 05:56 ET pick (keep mkt) stands; the two net-of-dc_mor rows are the SemiAnalysis level cuts without double counting the delays.

judgment_calls_for_kilian.question: How fast does D&C grow through the Dec-2027 InP capacity step?
judgment_calls_for_kilian.context: dc_capture = D&C revenue / mkt, built by part. The set books datacenter transceivers +12/+11/+10/+9/+8% q/q to Q2 FY28: internal InP capacity more than doubles Sep-2026 to Dec-2027 (~+15% a quarter) and transceivers follow a quarter later, less a growing shift of internal lasers replacing external supply (CEO: mix 'hasn't changed much', will shift over the coming quarters). Plus Scale Across x2 by Dec-2027, PhotonLink at the stated floors (the $20B LTA is its own driver lta_rev at 50% since 2026-11-17; 0%/100% realization move the target -/+4.7%); after CY2027 Scale Across grows +23% a year (Dell'Oro DCI optics) and PhotonLink outside the LTA grows with the optics market (TrendForce / Cignal AI CPO paths are faster), each sized under 2%. It is a call because the mix-shift drag is not quantified by the company and the base round had a much flatter path.

options.reasoning: Takes the CEO's capacity plan and lag, and the stated move toward internal lasers, which absorbs part of each capacity step; Q2 revenue 2,600 sits inside the 2.55-2.75B guide; FY27/FY28 revenue 11.10B / 14.87B (FY28 after the dc_mor haircut) vs Zacks 11.11B / 15.28B.
